Board decision 89 (owner, 2026-09-27, feature/1.1.13/wave2 commit 2718022613595482f60cb4ecdcfa435d972c6124): CLI tests inject only their own local-state directory through the CLI's internal entry; the composition graph, capability policy and external-tool discovery stay the production defaults and may not be substituted. This amends the accepted CLI test contract of VERIFY-111-SHADOW-ROOT-01, whose sealed record stays unchanged as history. The architecture test is renamed CliTestsInjectOnlyTheirLocalStateDirectoryIntoTheProductionCompositionRoot and asserts that the harness names no host, loader, policy or repository-root substitution and that CompositionHostServices.Create(string) composes BuiltInCanonicalCapabilityPolicy.Load with the default discovery loader.

Board decision 90 (same commit): NFC is an application, not a library; the composition API migrates without keeping old signatures and no compatibility is promised to code outside the repository. Migrated: both PresentationHostServices constructors gain string localStateDirectory after localFiles; DesktopApplication.Run gains string localStateDirectory; CompositionHostServices gains public Create(string localStateDirectory), public LocalStateDirectory and public static ResolveCurrentUserLocalStateDirectory, and its internal Create overloads require the directory; CliApplication gains an internal RunAsync overload taking Func<string> localStateDirectory; the public ShellPreferenceFileStore.DefaultPreferencesPath and the internal ReportHistoryFileStore.DefaultHistoryPath and LocalJsonDocument.GetDefaultPath are replaced by directory-based PathIn/GetPath. In-repository callers (Desktop Program, CLI, tests) are migrated in the same change.

Board decision 91 (same commit): scope is the four files; version-manager state isolation is a separate follow-up (draft BUG-20260927-version-manager-state-test-isolation); no claim is made that all local-state IO of a test process fails closed. The decision is a dated amendment to ADR 0079, appended verbatim (draft ADR-0079-amendment-2026-09-27-test-local-state.md) to v5 without changing v5. Integration (commander, 2026-09-27): batch 2c. Batch 2b merged by #459 (merge e6e991af32d76d99ad156a7f86baa662947db8d9) brought ADR 0079 v5 to the trunk and sealed the evidence checkpoint 241327de129cbbc1cd492070c3105ed91a03fe5f, which is this record's integrationBase; docs/adr/0079-test-architecture.md is a governed R2 path of this record. The earlier reviews at 9861d800c do not cover the trunk changes after that base; the r3 item below lists them.

Accepted tests whose literal shape changes: ProjectDependencyTests (renamed per decision 89), RepositoryBoundaryTests.DesktopHostConvergence (Create() becomes one ResolveCurrentUserLocalStateDirectory() and one Create(localStateDirectory); one host and no Bootstrap reference from Presentation remain pinned) and XamlControlStyleContractTests.CatalogWarmupUsesAccessibleRetryableForegroundLoadingSurface (the legacy PresentationHostServices constructor gains the trailing string localStateDirectory; nine-argument compatibility is no longer protected, per decision 90).

Why R2 rather than R1: the production resolver gains a fail-closed branch driven by a process runtime switch (a new configuration input declared for IsTestProject in the root Directory.Build.props), and public composition signatures change (decision 90). Directory.Build.props and docs/architecture/local-user-data-inventory.md are not governed paths; they are bound by the proposal patch hash and the review evidence, not by mutablePaths.

Proposal r3 (2026-09-27) = r2 rebased on trunk e6e991af3: 69 of r2's 70 files apply unchanged. Conflict: #459 (F08, commits 50740deec and 5508459b1) added a third constructor argument, the save-outcome callback, to both local-state coordinators in MainWindow.axaml.cs; r3 keeps that argument and only replaces DefaultHistoryPath and DefaultPreferencesPath with PathIn(hostServices.LocalStateDirectory), as r2 did. #459 also added five test files that used the default root: AcceptedExecutionAdmissionTests and CliExecutionRefusalTests (CompositionHostServices.Create(), and one internal Create without a directory), CliReportAtomicWriteTests (public CliApplication.RunAsync), ShellViewModelTests.ExecutionAdmission (two Create()), which now inject an isolated directory with the production policy and discovery unchanged; and LocalStateSaveNoticeTests (F08 regressions), whose static default-path keys become per-instance PreferencesPath/HistoryPath derived from the host's LocalStateDirectory inside the scripted store, with every assertion, failure script, hold and persisted-value check unchanged (34 references). A scan of r3 finds no remaining test call of Create(), the public CliApplication.RunAsync, DefaultHistoryPath, DefaultPreferencesPath or the LocalApplicationData folder outside the guard tests, and no production default-root resolution outside CompositionHostServices and the out-of-scope version-manager resolver.

Coverage limits: DesktopApplication.Run's startup preference read has no behavioral test (it starts the classic desktop lifetime); its directory is pinned by the architecture test. CliProgramTests now enters Program.Main only with no arguments; an unknown command is covered through the harness, so the process-entry composition branch is not behaviorally tested.

UiSmoke hang (review F-2), kept as an open failure: run full3 on the proposal at 2026-09-26 22:24 stopped after 458 passed tests; VSTest blame aborted it after 15 minutes of inactivity (exit 1). Classification: suspected Avalonia headless-session startup stall; root cause and relationship to this change remain undetermined. No direct causal link was identified by static review. Later passing runs do not close the failure, which is tracked as BUG-20260927-uismoke-headless-session-stall. Evidence is retained under D:\NvtFwCombiner-TestArea\evidence\tls-local-state\uismoke-hang-20260926-2239 (moved there from tests\NvtFwCombiner.UiSmoke.Tests\TestResults to keep the worktree clean; SHA-256: Sequence_af6bc426faab481fa504c42e3d52afd2.xml 881316983d073f50355531fe64d3722abe5315aef45fea7820b28961d0ac8974, NvtFwCombiner.UiSmoke.Tests_49780_20260926T223932_hangdump.dmp 03415cf8414a4e667b0d7c0591c61172be60ceb21c26249ade16279d77c742b7, testhost_47400_20260926T223932_hangdump.dmp 2c76b928a1deabc818decee93952045389cdaab97f512d3989e4146f176745a7, full3-UiSmoke.log c3118fdb228c7c6758b80e2a426937b5ba7c4117b0731d95047ef73094f00fc5). Observations: (1) the sequence has 478 started tests; the 20 never completed are all [AvaloniaFact]/[AvaloniaTheory] tests, the first of which started at position 74, and no Avalonia test completed, including RunReportsListTests.ReportSaveFailurePreservesReportAndNeverNotifiesSuccess, which builds no host and touches no local state, while 458 thread-pool tests (many composing hosts and loading catalogs) completed; (2) the test-process dump had loaded Avalonia.Headless, Avalonia.Skia and libSkiaSharp but not Avalonia.Markup.Xaml, Avalonia.Themes.Fluent or libHarfBuzzSharp, which a healthy control process on the same build loads after one Avalonia test; this is consistent with the application's XAML initialization not having completed, but does not prove it was never entered; (3) a symbol-free heuristic scan, which maps stack values to module ranges and cannot resolve managed or JIT-compiled frames, found every thread's instruction pointer in ntdll and no Avalonia or Skia module values on the scanned stacks; no child process was alive; (4) static review found no changed code on the headless-session setup path (AvaloniaHeadlessTestApplication, App and the Avalonia platform setup are unchanged; the stalled tests' segments before their first await add no synchronous wait; the switch is read only by CompositionHostServices), which does not exclude scheduling or timing effects of the change. Reproduction: two later complete UiSmoke runs of the same proposal in a temporary worktree (D:\NvtFwCombiner-TestArea\work\tls-hang-repro, since removed), with a stall watchdog and dotnet-trace ready, passed 1672/1672 each (7.5 and 8.8 minutes, while other worktrees ran tests); the stall occurred in one of five UiSmoke runs of the proposal. There is no failing run without the change and no established wait chain, so neither a pre-existing defect nor an environment cause is proven. Next step: analyze the retained dump's managed stacks with dotnet-dump or WinDbg with SOS (not installed; installing one downloads a package and needs the owner's approval).
semanticOwner: CompositionHostServices (Bootstrap composition root) owns the one current-user local-state resolver, ResolveCurrentUserLocalStateDirectory, and each host graph's LocalStateDirectory; the toolchain-runtime and Event Buffer format default paths derive from it. Presentation keeps its file names and JSON codec (ReportHistoryFileStore, ShellPreferenceFileStore, LocalJsonDocument) but receives the directory through PresentationHostServices and DesktopApplication.Run and no longer resolves a platform folder. Version-manager state keeps its separate resolver.
terminalContract: With the NvtFwCombiner.LocalState.CurrentUserFolderForbidden switch unset or false, executable composition roots (Desktop Program.Main, the public CliApplication.RunAsync overload, CompositionHostServices.Create()) resolve %LOCALAPPDATA%\NvtFwCombiner exactly as before and pass that one directory to the host graph and to Presentation; preferences.v1.json, report-history.v1.json, toolchain-runtime.v1.json and event-buffer-format.v1.json keep their names and resolved path strings. The CLI resolves the directory only when it composes a host. Every IsTestProject declares the switch as true through the root Directory.Build.props and no product runtimeconfig does; in such a process the default resolver of these four files throws InvalidOperationException before any of their local-state IO. The switch does not guard explicitly injected paths, child product processes or version-manager state, which keeps its own resolver (board decision 91). Test composition roots inject directories from TestSupport IsolatedLocalState: each allocation is a new directory under a per-process root in the test temporary area, so two allocations never share these files (a shared class fixture still shares its one host); a normal process exit attempts to delete the per-process root, and a killed or hung process or a failed delete can leave it behind. CLI tests inject only their directory through the internal CLI entry; graph, policy and external-tool discovery stay the production defaults (board decision 89). The composition API migrates without compatibility shims (board decision 90). No firmware bytes, ranges, CRC, profiles, output naming, local-state file formats, Event Buffer configuration semantics or version-manager state path change.
